editions.title: Dio's Rome, vol. 1: the epitome of the lost books 1–21
editions.notice: Books 7 to 9 only, which Foster translated as the epitome of Dio's lost books 1 to 21. He leaves out 7.2 to 7.5, 7.12 and 7.21 to 7.23 (our own translation has them), and runs 9.13 into 9.12.

editions.title: English translation
editions.notice: A machine translation made by this project with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) from 2 to 8 November 2026, from Dindorf's Greek (1868–75). The Preface, Books 1 to 6, the chapters of Book 7 that Foster leaves out, and Books 10 to 14 so far. It is not a translator's work: check it against the Greek, and report errors. Public domain (CC0): reuse it freely.
